APPROVE the bounded two-file JavaFX repair at 4361a3585d74ddeebd2ee886602b49655669e56b, base80841b66e3e7006b4df5082ec4889a7b92391c91. No blocking source/native-rendering finding. JavaFxCanvasContext.scala:269-291 measures logical/visual bounds at a common baseline, unions extents, and applies original logical horizontal advance and vertical origin. Public API/font resolution unchanged; glyph positions preserved. JavaFxInteractionHostSuite.scala:536-596 uses independently rendered native plate/ink planes across189 cases, including empty/space labels. The prior small-label test now identifies plate pixels separately from ink.
Independent reviewer-owned archive: native HostSuite21/21 passes; additional135 native font/label/anchor/0-33-90deg cases pass on candidate and fail unchanged on original renderer in7 cases. Candidate restored from exact Git blob and affected probe rerun successfully after negative control. All135 before/after ink planes are pixel-identical; candidate has zero outside ink; full outputs agree with independent premultiplied composition within2 channel units (max1.568627). Author144pt specimen independently recounted:1436 ink pixels,67 outside ->0. Own six-row actual native comparison and author diagnostic visually inspected.
Evidence .agent-work/javafx-plate-independent-review/README.md, pixel-report.json, comparison.png, source-provenance.json, sha256.json and three raw logs/meta. Author1981/16-target test receipts and external evidence hashes verified, not independently rerun broadly.
This scoped approval does NOT waive failed required full-format and compatibility receipts. Original baseline and candidate have same six unrelated core forward-navigation findings; TASTy not reached. Authorization remains absent. Shared main advanced to6ec0c47; proposer/coordinator must refresh target and integration evidence before landing. Parent text-plate acceptance stays in review because independent Canvas/SVG browser containment remains failed (43/156 and27/156 cases). Monocle headless/Prism software,72ppi rectangular opaque plates, host-resolved fonts; no all-font/hardware/release qualification. No production changes or landing by reviewer.
